result.title: Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning using Behavior Regularisation and Latent Feasibility Guidance
result.summary: Safe offline reinforcement learning (RL) seeks to learn policies that maximize return while satisfying safety constraints, using a static dataset. To characterize state-wise safety, reachability analysis identifies the feasible region, defined as the set of states from which constraints can be satisfied at every future step. Policies are commonly extracted from learned value functions with advantage-weighted regression (AWR). However, AWR relies on exponentiated weights that amplify value estimation errors, whereas behavior-regularized policy gradient methods directly utilize the action gradient of the value function and often make more effective use of learned critics. We propose Feasibility-Optimized Conditional Actor Learning (FOCAL), a method that incorporates behavior-regularized policy gradients into a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) actor. FOCAL optimizes this policy using a first-order objective partitioned by feasibility, updating the actor to increase return on transitions estimated to be feasible and to reduce constraint violations on transitions estimated to be infeasible. During inference, FOCAL dynamically adjusts the scale of the latent prior according to the estimated feasibility of the state to adjust the conservatism of action sampling. Theoretically, we show that for AWR, the policy update variance depends exponentially on the advantage error, whereas for FOCAL it scales linearly with the variance of the value estimation error. Across the DSRL benchmark, FOCAL satisfies the constraints on all evaluated tasks while achieving competitive or higher returns compared to baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FOCAL，在安全离线 RL 中把行为正则化策略梯度接入 CVAE actor，按估计可行性划分一阶目标分别优化回报与约束违反，并在推理时依据状态的可行性动态调整 latent 先验尺度以改变动作采样的保守程度。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关系，但其「可行区域」估计与依状态可行性调节 latent 采样尺度的做法，可能为 LVR 中是否继续 latent 计算（STOP 决策）和潜在状态的保守性控制提供概念类比，可供核查。
